integrity: Explicit all-parameter proof, exact generating series, two independent finite verification implementations; no independent external mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: Only the positional scattered 010 triple statistic (and its complemented 101 version) in binary two-binomial classes; intermediate support may have holes. The finite verification is not an infinite proof. Publication priority beyond the reviewed material, including unavailable full text of the motivating 2026 paper, is unverified.
title: Sharp scattered-triple spectra inside binary Parikh-matrix classes
